clip.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 UGC-style fashion try-on video for social media, 8 seconds, three quick cuts, natural phone-camera look, bright warm apartment with wood floors, an arched mirror and soft daylight. The presenter is an AI-generated young adult woman (not any real person) with long brunette hair, friendly and excited, speaking English directly to the camera. The dress is the exact caramel-brown cable-knit midi sweater dress from the reference images: mock neck, ribbed waistband, long sleeves with ribbed cuffs, vertical cable-knit pattern down the skirt with a diagonal wrap seam, fitted through the hip, midi length, and a front slit. Keep its color, knit pattern, neckline, waistband and slit identical to the references.
Shot 1 (0-2.5 s): wearing a casual white tee, she holds the caramel dress on a hanger up to the camera and says: "Okay, you need to see this sweater dress."
Shot 2 (2.5-5.5 s): cut to her wearing the dress, mid-shot, smoothing the ribbed waist and turning slightly, saying: "It's cable knit, and it's fitted through the hips."
Shot 3 (5.5-8 s): cut to a full-length shot in black knee-high boots; she takes big confident steps toward the camera that open the front slit and smiles.
Clear natural speech, light room tone, no background music, no on-screen text, no subtitles, no logos.

qa.result: visual pass with one flag; audio not verified
